state.native_contract: Packet getter acquires lock28, then reads pool head/tail/ID, advances head and updates allocation counters before releasing the lock. Original code ignores the acquire return. Selected RX return PCs are 0x8400b76a and 0x8400b898; unrelated users already have a TXDONE binding.
state.ownership_contract: Fresh cold epoch and bitmap state, immutable backing geometry, no duplicate/bad IDs, retained committed claims after late faults, checked native-head publication before descriptors, no release or reinitialize API.
state.integration_scope: Fixed packet geometry specializes the same tested C implementation while preserving page ABI and behavior. Compose the packet take only on an actual successful native lock grant and reviewed cold RX callers. Keep the lock through claim/head/counter publication, release an acquired lock once, then recheck lifetime. No physical grant/drain/coherency proof is implied.
